boss_mecha_golem.notes: One 1000x1000 sheet of 100x100 cells. Rows: 0 idle/move (4; run = the same 4 frames, as the pack says), 1 glow 8, 2 ranged arm shot 9 (attack), 3 block 8 (page says 9), 4 melee 7 (attack2), 5 laser cast 7, 6 armour buff 10 (page says 11), 7+8 defeated 14 (death; played backwards = appearance). Laser fx: beam starts at its left end and runs to the right edge of its 300 px cell; frame 0 of the laser sheet was empty and is dropped (14 frames remain: 8 charge + 6 beam).
